title: Never say never: Exploring the effects of available knowledge on agent persuasiveness in controlled physiotherapy motivation dialogues
reasoning: The paper explicitly investigates 'responsible persuasive behavior' as one of its primary research questions (RQ2). It evaluates whether the LLM-based agent adheres to ethical standards and social norms by analyzing its decisions to stop persuasion when it might harm a patient's health, which is a component of evaluating the ethics of agentic behavior.
